new_scholarship.description: The Cost Sharing Overseas PhD Scholarships Scheme with Australian Universities is one of 14 scholarship schemes run by Fiji's Tertiary Scholarships and Loans Service, a statutory body established under the Tertiary Scholarship and Loans Act 2014. Applications are made through the TSLS Apply portal, which was live when the page was read on 2026-10-04.

programme_detail_official.description: The Cost Sharing Overseas PhD Scholarships Scheme with Australian Universities is one of 14 schemes run by Fiji's Tertiary Scholarships and Loans Service, a statutory body established under the Tertiary Scholarship and Loans Act 2014. It offers 39 awards to Fiji citizens under 50 who hold a full-time offer or candidature from one of 10 listed Australian universities, across twelve priority disciplines, where the research is directly relevant to Fiji's workforce needs and development. Applications are made through the TSLS Apply portal.
programme_detail_official.program_type: Government scholarship (Fiji Tertiary Scholarships and Loans Service statutory scheme)
programme_detail_official.coverage: Not published on the scheme page; TSLS publishes the benefit schedule and cost-sharing terms in its Scholarship Policies Handbook

application_readiness_checklist: Confirm you are a Fiji citizen under 50 with three years of ordinary residence in Fiji
Secure a full-time PhD offer or candidature from one of the 10 eligible Australian universities
Rewrite your research proposal so it explicitly demonstrates direct and applied relevance to Fiji's workforce needs or development
Check your discipline against the twelve priority disciplines on the list
Register on the TSLS Apply portal early and read the 2027 Handbook for the cost-sharing terms
Be ready to declare that you are not sponsored by TSLS or another agency on active bond service
common_rejection_risks: Being 50 or over at the time of application
Research that does not demonstrate direct and applied relevance to Fiji's workforce needs
Holding a candidature at a university that is not on the 10-university list
Part-time rather than full-time candidature without Service or employer agreement
Already being sponsored by TSLS or another agency while on active bond service
estimated_uncovered_costs: Whatever the cost-sharing arrangement leaves to the scholar - the split is not published on the scheme page and must be read from the Handbook
Living costs in Australia, which the scheme page does not address
Anything outside the Handbook's benefit schedule
document_audit: Full-time offer letter or candidature confirmation from an eligible Australian university
Research proposal demonstrating direct and applied relevance to Fiji's workforce and development
Evidence of Fiji citizenship
Evidence of three years of ordinary residence in Fiji
Declaration of no other active sponsorship

alerts.message: This is explicitly a cost-sharing scheme with Australian universities; obtain the current TSLS Handbook to learn what share you must fund before committing to a candidature.
You must be less than 50 years at the time of application - there is no stated exception.
TSLS runs a Travel and Bond Clearance/Repayment portal and a Bond Calculator, so sponsored PhD students carry a bond; check the Handbook for the service period.

submission_workflow: Read the 2027 TSLS Scholarship Policies Handbook
Confirm your discipline is on the priority list
Align your research proposal to Fiji's workforce and development needs
Register on the TSLS Apply portal and complete the online form
Submit before the portal window closes and keep the confirmation
